text: You dropped your fucking Calendly link in the DM, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Auto DM, bio, stories. Booked all week, bro.
style: Proud and hyped, showing off to his buddy, a casual American guy.
Flat and deadpan, a trap question.
Unsure, trying to sound fine, a small beat before 'Like'.

text: So you're waving at yourself on Zoom. In public.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring 'In public'.

text: Third fucking no-show this week. These calls take real time and energy!
style: Exasperated and tired, venting fast to a friend, voice going up at the end.

text: Your link doesn't ask. No budget, no goal, no idea who you are.
style: Sly and calm, a little beat before each item, the last one landing.

text: Because it's free. Free to book, free to ghost.
style: Dry and punchy, one short beat per phrase, landing hard on the last word.

text: Wait, so I stop sending the link?
style: Small and hesitant, a little lost.

text: No. Make them earn it. Plug me into ManyChat, I ask your questions first.
style: A firm 'No.', then smooth and confident, a sly little offer.

text: And if they're not a fit?
They get something useful, like your free guide. Not your calendar.
style: Calm and easy, a short beat before 'Not your calendar'.

text: Paid Calendly? I offer two or three times in their time zone and book it, lead summary included.
style: Confident and smooth, listing it easily, a little smug.

text: Fine. How do I get you?
style: Sheepish, giving in, a small pause after 'Fine'.

text: Close the Zoom, bro. He's still asleep.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
